headline: Masco (MAS) Appoints Its First Chief Marketing Officer To Push Brand Growth
summary: Masco (NYSE:MAS) has appointed Brad Hiranaga as its first Chief Marketing Officer. The new role focuses on brand growth, digital acceleration, and customer-centric product and service development. Hiranaga joins Masco with prior leadership roles at Marriott, General Mills, and Cotopaxi. Masco is drawing fresh attention from investors with this new executive position centered on marketing and commercial execution. headline: Wall Street week ahead: monthly jobs report, McDonald's and SpaceX earnings
summary: Corporate earnings from big U.S. companies and closely-watched jobs reports are among the key updates for Wall Street this week.  The latest batch of profit updates and forecasts could help give investors a clearer picture of how and where households are spending money amid stubbornly high inflation.  Bleach and household products maker Clorox and hotel operator Marriott International report their latest results on Monday.
